notes: Cutting hair for a queue of NPC customers and being scored on each one is a defined, repeatable job loop, which Roleplay's own boundary note hands to Simulation as Role Sim rather than to social roleplay. I kept the Role Sim preset but replaced its world-open shape with interior-single from the wider catalogue, because the author said just one small barbershop with the build kept inside it - and for the same reason I dropped the preset's path-road-vehicle. interior-single carries no modifier and there is no outside-to-inside transition to link, so this stays P0 with no P3. Decided without a user: the queue itself is npc-population rather than a spawner, and I left physics-rig out because the comedy lives in the botched haircuts on the NPCs, not in any built contraption.
